notes:
• D&D 3.5e: the HUD works with the "Dungeons & Dragons 3.5 SRD" system (D35E 3.0 and later, verified on 3.1.0 with Foundry 13). The projection has eight tabs:
    • Character: abilities with their checks, the three saves, base attack, melee, ranged, grapple and initiative rolls, and size, speeds, senses, languages and resistances.
    • Attacks: every attack and full attack, with its damage and critical range.
    • Skills: one column, with ranks and totals; class skills and trained-only skills marked.
    • Spells: by spellbook and level, with caster level and DC. A prepared caster prepares copies with − and +; a spontaneous caster spends slots from segments.
    • Feats, Inventory, Effects and Biography: buffs are switched on and off from the Effects tab and their chips. Hit points go below zero, to −10, with Disabled and Dying shown, and nonlethal damage and negative levels sit beside them. Every roll goes through the system's own, with its dialogs. The latest-roll strip reads the system's cards, and the cards take the device's colors.
  • PF2e HUD: its shortcut slots no longer cover the projection. With its panel on the left, the HUD is drawn over it.
  • The Journal: a long character name is fitted to the page instead of running off it, and the Journal's text is a little smaller, so more fits on a line.
